title: A2A & Events
summary: This module manages inter-agent communication (A2A), including authentication, extensions, and the core event system for tracking and reacting to system activities.

nodes.label: A2A Core
nodes.title: A2A Core Module
nodes.description: Provides the fundamental mechanisms for Agent-to-Agent communication, including configuration, task execution wrappers, and agent card management.

nodes.label: A2A Authentication
nodes.title: A2A Authentication Module
nodes.description: Manages various client and server-side authentication schemes for secure Agent-to-Agent communication.

nodes.label: A2A Extensions & Updates
nodes.title: A2A Extensions and Updates Module
nodes.description: Handles client and server-side extensions for A2A communication, including UI extensions and various update mechanisms like polling and push notifications.

nodes.label: Event System
nodes.title: Event System Module
nodes.description: Provides a robust event bus for CrewAI, enabling event-driven architecture with synchronous and asynchronous handler management, and event recording.

nodes.label: Agent Management
nodes.title: Agent Management Module
nodes.description: Manages the lifecycle and execution of agents, including their interactions with LLMs and tools, often leveraging A2A capabilities.

nodes.label: Task & Flow Execution
nodes.title: Task and Flow Execution Module
nodes.description: Orchestrates the execution of tasks and complex flows, managing conditional logic, human feedback, persistence, and visualization of workflows, and can emit events.

groups.label: Agent-to-Agent Communication
groups.title: Agent-to-Agent Communication
groups.description: This group encompasses all components responsible for enabling secure, extensible, and efficient communication between AI agents.

groups.label: Event Management
groups.title: Event Management
groups.description: The central hub for all event-driven interactions, allowing components to publish and subscribe to system-wide events for observability and reactivity.

groups.label: Core Integrations
groups.title: Core Framework Integrations
groups.description: These modules represent the primary consumers and producers of A2A and event system functionalities within the CrewAI framework.
